```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r load}
library(tidyverse)
library(viridis)
df <- read_csv("../data/bc_full_factorial_dataset.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
hidden <- jsonlite::fromJSON("../data/hidden_truth.json")
cond_stats <- df %>%
  group_by(condition_id) %>%
  summarise(mean_yield = mean(BC_yield_gL), sd_yield = sd(BC_yield_gL),
            pH = first(pH), Temp_C = first(Temp_C), RPM = first(RPM),
            Inoculum_pct = first(Inoculum_pct), Sugar_gL = first(Sugar_gL),
            .groups = "drop")
```

## Exercise 1 — Vary the budget
```{r ex1, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
set.seed(42)
budgets <- c(10, 50, 100, 500)
results <- list()
for (b in budgets) {
  best_y <- replicate(100, {
    ids <- sample(cond_stats$condition_id, b, replace = FALSE)
    max(cond_stats$mean_yield[cond_stats$condition_id %in% ids])
  })
  results[[length(results) + 1]] <- tibble(budget = b, best_yield = best_y)
}
bind_rows(results) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(budget), y = best_yield)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(x = "Budget", y = "Best yield found (g/L)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Exercise 2 — Greedy refinement
```{r ex2}
set.seed(42)
best <- cond_stats %>% slice_sample(n = 50) %>% filter(mean_yield == max(mean_yield))

# One-level neighbours
neighbours <- cond_stats %>%
  filter(
    abs(pH - best$pH) <= 0.5,
    abs(Temp_C - best$Temp_C) <= 2.5,
    abs(RPM - best$RPM) <= 37.5,
    abs(Inoculum_pct - best$Inoculum_pct) <= 2.5,
    abs(Sugar_gL - best$Sugar_gL) <= 10
  )
refined <- neighbours %>% filter(mean_yield == max(mean_yield))
cat(sprintf("Before refinement: %.3f\n", best$mean_yield))
cat(sprintf("After refinement:  %.3f\n", refined$mean_yield))
```

## Exercise 3 — Measure the gap
```{r ex3, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
set.seed(42)
true_best <- max(cond_stats$mean_yield)
budgets <- seq(10, 500, by = 10)
gaps <- sapply(budgets, function(b) {
  gap <- replicate(50, {
    ids <- sample(cond_stats$condition_id, b, replace = FALSE)
    true_best - max(cond_stats$mean_yield[cond_stats$condition_id %in% ids])
  })
  mean(gap)
})
tibble(budget = budgets, gap = gaps) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = budget, y = gap)) +
  geom_line(colour = "firebrick", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = "Budget", y = "Mean gap to brute-force best (g/L)",
       title = "Gap closes with more evaluations") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Exercise 4 — Multiple restarts
```{r ex4}
set.seed(42)
perfs <- replicate(10, {
  ids <- sample(cond_stats$condition_id, 50, replace = FALSE)
  max(cond_stats$mean_yield[cond_stats$condition_id %in% ids])
})
cat(sprintf("Best:  %.3f\n", max(perfs)))
cat(sprintf("Worst: %.3f\n", min(perfs)))
cat(sprintf("Median: %.3f\n", median(perfs)))
cat(sprintf("Mean:   %.3f\n", mean(perfs)))
```
